title: A counterexample to Kusner's conjecture on equilateral sets
summary: We disprove Kusner's 1983 conjecture that every equilateral set in $\ell_p^n$ with $2 57$. This is the first equilateral set of more than $n+1$ points in $\ell_p^n$ for any finite $p\ge2$. The construction persists on an open interval of exponents around $5$; since Ge, Xu and Zhou recently proved the conjecture for $2\le p\le4$, the infimum of exponents at which it fails lies in $[4,5)$. The configuration is the unique solution of an explicit polynomial system with rational coefficients in a rational box, established in exact arithmetic.
